sections_read: Can I use PLACES to track local changes over time?
provenance_facts: CDC says current modeling does not support tracking local change over time
subcounty poststratification uses fixed decennial population; county uses annual population estimates
time is not a model variable
entries.uncertainty: Current page can change; archive raw HTML/PDF in a network-enabled execution environment.
side_findings: CDC discourages program/policy evaluation from local differences alone

provenance_facts: MRP uses BRFSS plus ACS/Census inputs
county and subcounty population bases differ
PLACES reports modeled estimates and 95% intervals
entries.uncertainty: Historical methodology versions still need byte-archived copies.
